storageArchitectureAnalysis.r2FreeTierAssessment: Cloudflare R2 provides 10 GB of free persistent storage every month with $0 egress bandwidth fees. With our multi-resolution WebP optimization (~680 KB per complete CDN variant set), the platform can host up to ~14,700 items completely free of charge.
storageArchitectureAnalysis.detailedRationale: Cloudflare R2 (current single bucket with versioned prefix /v1/) is strongly recommended for the first 10,000–50,000 items. Zero egress fees eliminate unpredictable bandwidth bills. If video or raw uncompressed master archives exceed 250 GB in future phases, a hybrid model (R2 for web-optimized CDN assets + Backblaze B2 for cold master archival preservation) can be introduced seamlessly.
